operations_plan.summary: Identify the usable lower rear-panel region and construct a fully constrained, horizontally oriented 200 mm by 100 mm rounded-rectangle profile with 10 mm corner radii. Assume a blind pocket because the request specifies a 30 mm depth.

steps.description: Select the large, approximately planar rear-facing surface of the rear rounded cover in the -Y view. Resolve it programmatically from faces 79-90 as the largest face whose outward normal is predominantly -Y and whose projection forms the plain rear panel. Exclude the top black trim, side fillets, lower base rail, feet, and rounded perimeter transition faces. The exact broad rear face ID is unresolved within the supplied grouped face range and must be identified by surface area, normal direction, and adjacency.

Create a sketch on the identified rear-facing surface, or on a datum plane tangent and parallel to its central planar region if the selected B-spline face is not suitable for a stable sketch attachment. Orient sketch horizontal along global X and vertical along global Z; the pocket direction will be inward toward +Y from the rear.

Project or reference the usable left, right, and bottom boundaries of the rear cover into the sketch. Use the boundaries where the broad rear surface begins transitioning into its side and lower corner fillets, rather than the overall silhouette of the feet or base trim. Construct a vertical centerline at the midpoint between the usable left and right boundaries and a horizontal bottom datum at the upper edge of the preserved lower base/corner region.

Draw one closed rounded rectangle with an overall width of 200 mm along X, an overall height of 100 mm along Z, and four tangent corner arcs of radius 10 mm. Constrain opposite straight segments parallel, constrain the profile symmetric about the rear-panel vertical centerline, and dimension the overall extents rather than the tangent lengths. Confirm that the source model uses millimetres; otherwise convert 20 cm, 10 cm, 3 cm, and 1 cm to 200 mm, 100 mm, 30 mm, and 10 mm.

Position the profile in the lower portion of the rear panel. Fix its horizontal center to the rear-panel centerline. Compute nominal side clearance as one half of the usable rear-panel width minus 200 mm, and use approximately that same value as the opening's bottom clearance from the preserved lower panel boundary. If exact equality is infeasible because of the rear-panel proportions, fillets, base rail, or feet, preserve equal left and right margins and select the nearest practical lower vertical position with positive material clearance around the complete profile. The phrase 'more or less equally distanced' is unresolved as an exact dimension, so implement it as this best-fit relational constraint rather than an absolute offset.

operations_plan.summary: Create the requested 30 mm-deep rounded-rectangle recess by subtracting the constrained profile inward from the rear enclosure while preserving the surrounding casing and internal mechanisms.

steps.description: Before cutting, extrude a temporary clearance volume from the rounded-rectangle sketch 30 mm inward along +Y and perform an interference check against all solids. The intended target is the rear cover solid 8; include main body solid 6 in the subtraction only if it physically overlaps the required 30 mm cavity and forms continuous enclosure material behind the cover. Do not cut the lower chassis, closure plates, feet, front controls, brew assembly, steam wand, drip tray, cups, or any internal mechanism. Internal equipment locations are unresolved from the supplied exterior geometry, so stop and flag the 30 mm depth for review if the clearance volume intersects protected non-enclosure solids.

Apply a blind pocket or Boolean subtraction using the rounded-rectangle profile, normal to the rear sketch plane and directed 30 mm inward toward +Y. Set the exact pocket depth to 30 mm and retain the generated back wall, four straight pocket walls, and four radius-controlled corner walls. Treat 'opening' as a blind recessed pocket because a finite depth is explicitly specified; do not convert it to a through-all cut unless downstream design intent explicitly overrides this interpretation.

Recompute the enclosure and verify that the subtraction produces one clean, open rear-facing cavity without detached sliver bodies, self-intersections, or breakthrough into the front service bay. Preserve the existing rear-panel perimeter, edge fillets, top trim, side seams, lower corner structures, underside plates, and all four support feet. Do not add extra edge fillets or chamfers to the pocket mouth because the requested 10 mm radius applies to the profile corners, not to the depth-direction edges.

operations_plan.summary: Validate the final rear recess dimensions, placement, topology, and preservation of all unaffected coffee-machine assemblies.

steps.description: Measure the completed feature in the rear view and verify an overall opening width of 200 mm, overall height of 100 mm, blind depth of 30 mm, and four plan-view corner radii of 10 mm. Verify that the 200 mm dimension is horizontal along X and the 100 mm dimension is vertical along Z.

Verify placement by measuring equal left and right clearances from the opening to the usable rear-panel side boundaries. Confirm that the bottom clearance is approximately equal to those side clearances where the available geometry permits, and that the opening remains visibly within the lower rear panel without entering the lower base rail, feet, side fillets, or top trim.

Run a final body-validity and interference check. Confirm that all front operating and dispensing geometry in sections SEC-03 through SEC-08 remains unchanged, that the machine envelope outside the localized rear recess is preserved, and that no protected component intersects the new cavity. Record the new negative feature as a rear access or mounting recess associated with SEC-02 rather than as a separate physical solid.
